approved_payload.content: A man was shot dead outside the Lingelethu West police station in Khayelitsha at about 3.10am, after a quarrel at Ace's Park tavern with an off-duty constable from Public Order Policing in Faure, IPID spokesperson Phaladi Shuping told IOL and City Vision. IPID says the man followed the constable's car to the police station, where they quarrelled again and the constable allegedly shot him. Officers at the station then shot the constable, who was taken to hospital. IPID is investigating. The reports disagree on the date: IOL says the early hours of Friday 20 November, City Vision says Thursday 19 November. The map point is approximate: the Khayelitsha point, not the police station.
